decision.statistical_scope: Simultaneous raw median intervals assume independent process repetitions and common medians. The expanded effect interval additionally assumes effect nuisance shifts are bounded by the same-role controls. Compatibility does not prove that model. Fresh process identities do not establish statistical independence.
